Bundled dependencies for private, browser-based spellchecking:

- Typo.js 1.2.5: https://www.npmjs.com/package/typo-js/v/1.2.5
  Source: https://github.com/cfinke/Typo.js
  License: LICENSE-Typo.txt (BSD).
- English US and UK Hunspell dictionaries from https://github.com/wooorm/dictionaries
  (`dictionaries/en` and `dictionaries/en-GB`, downloaded November 6, 2026).
  Original licensing notices: LICENSE-en-US and LICENSE-en-GB.

These files are served by the site itself. No remote dictionary requests or
third-party proofreading requests are needed for automatic spelling checks.
